title: We build the book
meta_description: Song Bird Publishing is a small independent press offering editing, design, formatting, distribution, launch support and author coaching.

hero.line: Working with you, not against you.
hero.sub:
We're a small independent press for authors who'd rather own their book than rent it. 

We also offer editing and design, whether that's book or website, assistance.

about.heading: Friends helping Friends
about.lede: Publishing has never been friendlier to new writers, and it has never been easier to get taken for a ride. We are here to support you.
about.body:
Song Bird is just starting to take flight. That means your editor knows your manuscript rather than your file number, and that the person who answers your email is the person doing the work.

You keep your rights. You keep your royalties. You approve the cover before anyone else sees it. We'll tell you when a chapter isn't working, and we'll tell you when a market isn't worth chasing — that's what you're paying us for.
about.pull_quote: The bird in our mark is nesting in nails. Most good books get built out of whatever hard thing was lying around.

services.label: Editorial
services.title: Editing
services.body: Developmental notes, line editing, and copyediting. We start with what the book is trying to be, then argue with the sentences.

services.label: Visual
services.title: Cover & interior design
services.body: Covers built for the shelf and the thumbnail. Original type and art — no stock photo you'll spot on someone else's spine.

services.label: Production
services.title: Formatting
services.body: Print-ready interiors and clean reflowable ebooks. Correct front matter, working table of contents, no surprises at the printer.

services.label: Reach
services.title: Distribution
services.body: ISBNs, metadata, and placement across major retail and library channels — set up so bookstores can actually order you.

services.label: Launch
services.title: Marketing & launch
services.body: A dated plan: advance readers, review outreach, pricing, and the first ninety days. Written down, so you know what happens next.

services.label: Guidance
services.title: Author coaching
services.body: For the book that's stuck, or the career that is. Standing sessions on structure, habit, and the decisions nobody warned you about.

submissions.heading: Open for manuscripts
submissions.closed_message: Submissions are closed at the moment. Check back — we'll post here when they reopen.
guidelines: A query of one page or less: what the book is, who it's for, who you are.
The first three chapters, or the first 25 pages of a manuscript without chapters.
A one-page synopsis, including the ending. Yes, really the ending.
Word or PDF, double spaced, 12pt, pages numbered.
Fiction, memoir, poetry, and practical nonfiction. No screenplays.
Simultaneous submissions are fine — just tell us if someone else says yes.

steps.title: You send it in
steps.body: Use the form below or email the submissions address. You'll get a confirmation the same week.

steps.title: We read it
steps.body: Expect a real answer within six weeks. If we pass, we'll say briefly why.

steps.title: We talk
steps.body: A call about the book, the timeline, and the money — with the terms in writing before anything is signed.

steps.title: We build the book
steps.body: Edit, design, produce, launch. You approve every stage, and you keep your rights throughout.

contact.heading: Get in touch
contact.response_time: Queries within six weeks. Everything else, a few days.
contact.note: Before you write: the submissions section above answers most of it. If your question is in there, sending it anyway just puts you further back in the queue — and we'd rather be reading your pages.
